item.title: Money, utility functions, and equality
item.description: Wealth inequality is a function of: Homogenous utility functions and a critical underproduction of a single good Wealth equality is a function of: Heterogenous utility functions No critical underproduction of a single good Thus wealth equality would seem like a good thing.
